analysis.name: COMPASS_2013_I1204782
analysis.description: Published A(gamma N -> D0 X) in D0 transverse-momentum and laboratory-energy bins, including charge conjugates. Tables 5–7 contain 45 points across three decay-sample groups. No Rivet event analysis or Herwig production configuration is enabled yet.

simulation.reason: Reference data only: a validated polarized massive-charm muoproduction calculation and the measurement's reconstruction/weighting treatment are required. The existing massless DIS campaign cards cannot provide this comparison.
requirements: Validated massive gamma* g -> c cbar production in the low-Q2 muon–nucleon regime, with appropriate helicity cross sections and any claimed higher-order terms.
A documented treatment of the combined proton/deuteron measurement; no arbitrary target fractions or inherited SIDIS deuteron factors.
D* tagging, D0 decay reconstruction (including the unobserved pi0 channel), Table 4 cuts, and the exclusive candidate-priority convention.
A validated approximation or response for the signal-purity, acceptance and depolarisation weights used in the published estimator.
A Rivet event implementation and independent kinematic, normalization, helicity and end-to-end validation.

physics.beam: Positive muons, nominal momentum 160 GeV/c, fixed target
physics.target: Published combined proton and deuteron data, 2002–2007; target-specific mixture weights are not supplied in Tables 5–7
physics.dominant_process: Photon–gluon fusion to a massive charm pair, mostly quasi-real photons
physics.observable: A_gammaN for reconstructed open-charm samples, not inclusive A1 or a directly measured gluon PDF
physics.hard_scale_in_paper: mu^2 = 4 (m_c^2 + p_T^2), with D-meson p_T used to approximate charm-quark p_T
physics.theory_status: No Herwig prediction; the paper's fitted LO/NLO Delta g/g values are not registered as event observables
